newsitem.title: UK: TABLE-GLYNWED H1 PRETAX PROFIT EDGES AHEAD.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-GLYNWED H1 PRETAX PROFIT EDGES AHEAD.

text.p: NOTE - Engineering group Glynwed International Plc said the abolition of tax credits on dividend payments in the recent UK budget would result in an increase in the group's pension charge in the second half of the year.

Chairman Gareth Davies said in his results statement that it was too early to quantify the effect on profits but the pension charge increase would "certainly outweigh" the benefits of the new cut in UK corporation tax rates.

Davies said he was "cautiously optimistic" for the full year results. He warned that if sterling's strength persisted, it could offset progress being made in rationalising the business, but then suggested that market conditions could save the day.

"The impact of the strength of sterling will be offset if UK consumer spending remains strong, the increasingly important U.S. markets remain buoyant and continental Europe continues its gradual recovery.
"Against this complex background we remain cautiously optimisitc about the out-turn for the year."
